mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parcel_trace (parcel_id, node, title, location, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role, detail, happened_at) VALUES (#{parcelId}, #{node}, #{title}, #{location}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorRole}, #{detail}, COALESCE(#{happenedAt}, now()))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM parcel_trace WHERE parcel_id = #{parcelId} ORDER BY happened_at, id
mapper.sql: t.*, p.tracking_no, p.courier_company, p.status AS parcel_status, s.name AS station_name, u.real_name AS owner_name
FROM parcel_trace t JOIN parcel p ON p.id = t.parcel_id JOIN station s ON s.id = p.station_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.owner_id

where.if: AND (p.tracking_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR t.operator_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR t.location ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR t.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.real_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE happened_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS "today", count(*) FILTER (WHERE node = 'INSPECT') AS "inspections", count(DISTINCT operator_id) FILTER (WHERE operator_role IN ('STAFF','ADMIN')) AS "inspectors", count(DISTINCT parcel_id) AS "parcels", count(DISTINCT location) AS "locations" FROM parcel_trace
SELECT node AS "name", count(*) AS "value" FROM parcel_trace GROUP BY node ORDER BY "value" DESC

SELECT t.operator_id AS "userId", t.operator_name AS "realName", t.operator_role AS "role", count(*) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.node = 'INSPECT') AS "inspections", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.node IN ('PICKUP','PICKUP_IDENTITY')) AS "pickups", max(t.happened_at) AS "lastAt" FROM parcel_trace t WHERE t.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND t.operator_role IN ('STAFF','ADMIN') GROUP BY t.operator_id, t.operator_name, t.operator_role ORDER BY "total" DESC LIMIT #{limit}
